title: Vertical shores.
officialText:
Vertical shores incorporated in multi-stage shores shall be set plumb and in alignment with
lower tiers so that loads from upper tiers are transferred directly to the lower tiers, or adequate transfer members shall be
provided. Provision shall be made to transfer the lateral loads to the ground or to completed construction of adequate
strength. Vertical shores shall be so erected that they cannot tilt, and shall have firm bearing. Inclined shores and the bearing
ends of all shores shall be braced against slipping or sliding. The bearing surfaces shall be cut square and have a tight fit at
splices.
